_comment: Farm & Field (3D/props/farm-field): how fields are drawn. Models are 'farm:NAME' (see data/props.json 'roots'). Crops are instanced in rows (grain: 2 m segments, neighbours touching so the field reads as one crop) or on a grid (heads). Crops cast no shadows and fade out beyond crop_visibility_range meters; the furrowed bed carries the read from far away.
_bed: The field's soil: a raised bed with sloped edges and furrows between the rows (vertex colours, no texture).
_fence: Field fences follow the charter (index 0 Hamlet .. 3 Town): woven wattle hurdles, split rails, paled fencing. Segments are 2 m, stretched a little to fit each side; the gate stands on the side facing the farmhouse.
